content_sections.heading: About FMU Project Associate
content_sections.text: Fakir Mohan University is a university located at Vyasa Vihar, Balasore, Odisha-756089. This Project Associate post falls under the "Agriculture" vertical of the ANRF-PAIR Network, in which Fakir Mohan University works with National Institute of Technology, Rourkela. The post serves a microproject on climate-smart and sustainable agriculture that uses geospatial techniques, AI/ML tools and advanced forecasting systems, with Prof. M. Mishra as the Principal Investigator.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Master's Degree or Four Years Bachelor's Degree in Geography or Environmental Management with specialization in Remote Sensing & GIS or any equivalent discipline from a recognized University or equivalent. (a) National Eligibility Tests – CSIR/UGC NET (JRF/LS/PhD) or GATE. (b) Selection process (for PhD) through national-level examinations conducted by Central Government Departments, their Agencies, and Institutions such as DST, DBT, DAE, DOS, DRDO, MoE, ICAR, ICMR, IIT, IISc, IISER, NISER etc. (c) Expertise in geospatial analytics, Python, R programming, big data processing and remote sensing applications. The notice does not mention an age limit or a minimum experience requirement. It states that details regarding qualifications, experience and other conditions are available on the university website, https://fmuniversity.nic.in ; candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for FMU Project Associate
content_sections.text: The notice asks for the application in the prescribed format, sent by email to the Principal Investigator. It does not attach the format itself, and it does not mention an email subject line. Prepare the application in the prescribed format. Attach the necessary supporting documents. Email the completed application to the Principal Investigator, Prof. M. Mishra, at [email protected] . Make sure the email reaches on or before 3 December 2026 (5.00 PM). Completed application in the prescribed format Necessary supporting documents

content_sections.text: Applications will be used to shortlist candidates for an interview. The exact date and time of the interview will be communicated to the shortlisted candidates separately; the notice does not mention the interview venue or mode.
